$comment: Narrow, dated exceptions to the deploy dependency audit (scripts/deploy-audit-gate.mjs). Each entry names one advisory on one package, the reason, the founder decision that admitted it, and an expiry. An expired entry fails the gate; it never lapses silently into a pass.

exceptions.reason: Production already runs zod 3.25.76 (runtime d49dbc98d), so deploying canonical adds no exposure. The fix requires zod >=4.6.6, a breaking major upgrade that needs its own migration and testing.
exceptions.decision: Founder, 2026-10-31: admit as a dated exception so the production-lineage reconciliation can deploy; track the zod 4 upgrade separately.
